items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Doc Cheatham, Briscoe, and Joe Williams, a terrific guitarist.

ctx.x: Speaking of Doc Cheatham, who else was in your group?

Doc Cheatham, Briscoe, and Joe Williams, a terrific guitarist. He made a banjo sound like a guitar and I loved it, because banjos - I used to hate the sound of them. He was very good. Briscoe and a drummer - I have forgotten his name completely. Later on with Seymour and Jeanette
